functional_semantics.triton: Grouped 3-D cross-correlation, no bias, isotropic stride/padding passed as d/h/w triples (197-202), zero padding by masking, floor formulas for out_D/out_H/out_W (impl_triton.py 44-51, 69-91, 174-176).
functional_semantics.cutile: Same semantics: flattened (ic_local, kd, kh, kw) reduction, clamp+mask zero padding, same output shape (impl_cutile.py 59-64, 81-124, 193-195, 213-214).
functional_semantics.note: Both realise F.conv3d(input, weight, bias=None, stride, padding, groups) (impl_torch.py 7-14); output (batch, out_channels, out_D, out_H, out_W) in the input dtype.

stages.triton: torch.empty output (179-180) then one implicit-GEMM kernel launch over (ceil(batch*out_DHW/rows), ceil(Cout_g/cols), groups) (impl_triton.py 223-247).
stages.cutile: torch.empty output (198-199), flat views (201-203), one implicit-GEMM kernel launch with the same 3-axis grid (impl_cutile.py 246-255).
stages.note: Identical single-kernel structure; no im2col, no padded copy, no second pass.

dependencies.triton: Output tiles independent; only the in-program sequential reduction loop (impl_triton.py 65-118).
dependencies.note: No inter-program dependency on either side.

reduction_scan_sort.triton: Sequential loop over Cin_g*kD*kH*kW flattened channel-major, then kd, kh, kw; chunks folded by tl.dot into one fp32 accumulator; no split-K/atomics (impl_triton.py 62-74, 118).
reduction_scan_sort.cutile: Same flattening (81-86) and sequential chunk loop folded by ct.mma into one fp32 accumulator; no split-K/atomics (impl_cutile.py 77-86, 146-147).
reduction_scan_sort.note: Same reduction structure and enumeration order.

precision.triton: fp32 accumulator (59); tl.dot(..., input_precision="tf32") (118); cast to output dtype at store (130).
precision.cutile: fp32 accumulator (72); operands cast to ct.tfloat32 for fp32 inputs, else native (75, 146-147); cast before scatter (170).
precision.note: Same precision class: TF32 operands for fp32, fp32 accumulation, output in input dtype. config.yaml verify atol 5e-1 / rtol 1e-2 (lines 1-3), looser than 1-D/2-D for the longer reduction.

preprocessing.triton: Contiguity asserts and scalar metadata only (169-177); no cast/transpose/pack; nothing cached (impl_triton.py 169-221).
preprocessing.cutile: Contiguity asserts, scalar metadata, zero-copy .view(-1) (188-203); nothing cached (impl_cutile.py 188-220).

intermediate_storage.cutile: None; accumulator in tile space, output written once via scatter (impl_cutile.py 72, 171).
intermediate_storage.note: No global scratch on either side.

mutation.triton: No input written; output freshly allocated per call (impl_triton.py 179-180).
mutation.cutile: No input written; output freshly allocated per call (impl_cutile.py 198-199).
mutation.note: Idempotent on both sides; contract forbids mutation.

fq_boundary.bytes_expr: batch * in_channels * D * H * H * dtype_size + out_channels * (in_channels // groups) * kernel_size ** 3 * dtype_size + batch * out_channels * ((D + 2 * padding - kernel_size) // stride + 1) * ((H + 2 * padding - kernel_size) // stride + 1) ** 2 * dtype_size
fq_boundary.flops_expr: 2 * batch * out_channels * ((D + 2 * padding - kernel_size) // stride + 1) * ((H + 2 * padding - kernel_size) // stride + 1) ** 2 * (in_channels // groups) * kernel_size ** 3
fq_boundary.note: config.yaml 28-38. Assumes W = H and a cubic kernel as the generator guarantees (tensors.py 355-361). Counts one read of input and weight, one write of output and 2 flops per MAC; both run() bodies contain only metadata, an uninitialised output allocation and one kernel. Cache re-reads of overlapping windows are uncounted on both sides equally.
